#Here are some cool plots

Here's a scatterplot

Set Up
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(p8105.datasets)
```


```{r}
plot_df =
  tibble(
    x= rnorm(100,2,3),
    y= x + rnorm(100)
  )
plot_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x=x, y=y)) +
  geom_point ()
```
